A cast copper-alloy cosmetic mortar of late Iron Age to the early Roman period. The mortar is incomplete, lacking both terminals so a specific type cannot be given. Otherwise the mortar can be described as U-shaped in section and pointed-oval-shaped in plan. The outer faces bear some decoration, which was probably symmetrical but now obscured due to corrosion.
